worlds.label: Blight Earth → Cooper Station continuum
worlds.description: One history; anomalies always included Cooper's messages

events.label: Blight Earth; gravitational anomalies in Murph's room
events.description: On a dying, dust-choked Earth, Cooper's daughter Murph insists a 'ghost' in her bedroom is pushing books off her shelves - strange gravitational goings-on no one can explain.

events.label: Dust/binary coordinates lead to NASA — Cooper was the ghost
events.description: The 'ghost' has left coordinates in the dust, leading Cooper and Murph to a hidden NASA base. Cooper later realises the ghost was himself, reaching back across time.

events.label: Endurance launches through Saturn wormhole
events.description: Cooper leaves his family and blasts off with a small crew through the wormhole near Saturn, carrying humanity's last hopes on the ship Endurance.

events.label: Miller's planet: 1 hour ≈ 7 years; Doyle dies; +23 years Earth
events.description: On the first candidate world, oceans waist-deep and a beached shipwreck, every hour costs seven years back home. A giant wave kills Doyle, and decades have passed on Earth by the time they escape.

events.label: Mann betrayal; Endurance damaged; Mann dies
events.description: Dr Mann, the cowardly 'best of us', fakes his data and tries to seize the ship; the docking accident that follows cripples the Endurance and kills him.

events.label: Gargantua slingshot; Cooper and TARS eject
events.description: To escape the black hole Gargantua, Cooper slingshots the ship using its gravity, then ejects himself and the robot TARS into the dark so Amelia can go on alone.

events.label: Fall into tesseract: infinite Murph bedrooms across time
events.description: Falling into Gargantua, Cooper finds himself inside a strange space where his daughter's bedroom stretches out in every direction across the years - a place built to let him touch the past.

events.label: Cooper pushes gravity messages into past (books, dust, watch)
events.description: Inside that impossible space, Cooper becomes the 'ghost' of Murph's childhood: he shoves the books, rakes the dust into lines, and desperately taps out messages across time.

events.label: Watch Morse delivers quantum data; Murph solves gravity
events.description: In one last gesture, Cooper encodes the quantum data TARS gathered inside the second hand of his daughter's watch, ticking it out in Morse code across the years.

events.label: Plan A habitats; humanity evacuates
events.description: With the quantum data, Murph finishes Professor Brand's equation and lifts humanity off the dying Earth into space habitats - the plan everyone was told was a lie.

events.label: Cooper wakes on Cooper Station; reunites with elderly Murph
events.description: Cooper is rescued and wakes aboard a huge space station named after him, where he is reunited with Murph - now an old woman surrounded by her family - on her deathbed.

events.label: Cooper leaves to find Amelia on Edmunds's world
events.description: Having said goodbye to his daughter, Cooper takes a small ship and sets off alone across the stars to find Amelia Brand on the world she was trying to reach.

events.label: Miller planet dilation loss
events.description: A few hours spent splashing around on the water world cost Cooper twenty-three years back on Earth - his children grow up without him in what feels like moments.

events.label: Tesseract bookshelf messages
events.description: Cooper, caught beyond the black hole, reaches back through his daughter's bedroom wall across the years, nudging books and dust to guide his family.

events.label: Murph solves gravity with watch data
events.description: The watch's ticking message lets Murph crack the gravity equation, and the plan to move humanity off Earth finally works.

events.label: Cooper farm; dust bowl Earth
events.description: Cooper is a widowed former pilot turned farmer in a world slowly suffocating in dust storms, raising his son and clever daughter on a failing corn farm.

events.label: Secret NASA mission
events.description: Cooper and Murph discover a secret, officially defunct NASA still working to save humanity - and its leader wants Cooper to pilot the mission through the wormhole.

events.label: Enter wormhole near Saturn
events.description: The crew steer the Endurance through the wormhole that appeared near Saturn, a shortcut across the galaxy placed there by something unknown.

events.label: Cooper falls into Gargantua
events.description: Alone in a damaged lander, Cooper lets himself be pulled over the edge of the black hole Gargantua - and falls out of the universe as he knew it.

events.label: Murph solves gravity with data
events.description: Using the data her father sent her through the watch, Murph completes the equation that lets humanity leave Earth.

events.label: Wake on Cooper Station
events.description: Cooper wakes in a hospital bed on the orbital station that bears his name, where an elderly Murph tells him no parent should outlive their child - and sends him off to find Brand.

edges.label: future humans enable tesseract that enables data

ruleEffects.effect: Messages were always Murph's childhood anomalies; timeline stays self-consistent
Quantum data and wormhole placement lack external origin outside the loop
Cooper becomes the ghost he already was

outcome.summary: One fixed history: future humans bootstrap the wormhole/tesseract so Cooper can send the quantum data that saves Earth; dilation is costly but not branching.
